Checked the "Set a budget" task checkbox on a saved checklist; Progress bar updated instantly from 0% to 17% (1/6), and Dashboard's overall Planning Progress and saved-checklist summary ("1 of 6 completed") updated correspondingly.

The "12+ Months Before" checklist contains 6 practical, specific tasks (Set a budget, Choose a wedding date, Book your venue, Start your guest list, Hire a wedding planner, Book photographer & videographer) each with a helpful description, and 5 other checklists cover Ceremony, Reception, Attire, and Honeymoon planning stages — providing comprehensive, practical reference content across the wedding timeline.
